name: Connections Summer Expeditions
description_short: Overnight backpacking/climbing and sea kayaking/camping expeditions on Cathleen Stone Island and in Boston Harbor for rising 7th and 8th graders enrolled in Boston Public Schools. Students cook, set up shelters, and learn wilderness skills, teamwork and environmental stewardship.
swim_waterfront_notes: Kayaking expeditions paddle Boston Harbor in two-person sea kayaks. Instruction covers paddling, capsize and rescue procedures, weather forecasting and navigation. No kayaking or outdoor experience needed.
